text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This won't do... I have to tell Trainer 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm so sorry, Trainer. I seem to have 
gained weight..."
choice_data_list: Is that so... Did something happen?
Is that so... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was someone who never neglected 
self-management and was a total stranger 
to an unhealthy lifestyle. Wondering about 
the reason, I asked her—
choice_data_list: そうなんだ……何かあったのか？
そうなんだ……何かあったの？

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I've been helping out with 
baking sweets and cooking with my friends 
nonstop, so...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I end up eating too much when 
taste-testing. I just really want to give 
them proper, thoughtful feedback, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I did consider turning down the help 
altogether, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Whenever I think it's a 
chance to help someone accomplish 
something, I just can't resist.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I consider it a great honor. I truly want 
to stand by you and be of help...
choice_data_list: In that case, taste-testing is a must.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... what sort of thing is that?
choice_data_list: それなら、味見することを大前提にしよう

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can never refuse a taste test. If so, 
we can simply treat it as a supplemental 
snack and adjust her dinner portions 
accordingly.
choice_data_list: 味見のある日は『分食』の考え方を使うんだ
味見のある日は『分食』の考え方を使うの

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... That's fantastic! Trainer, 
yes please, I would love that.
choice_data_list: 手伝いが続けられるメニューを考えるよ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa mastered managing calorie 
intake while continuing to help out. She 
succeeded in dieting in a healthy, 
reasonable way.
